== Summary ==
Lead crop of [[File:Trevor Partridge 2019 Match Play Championship interview.jpg]]: [[Trevor Partridge]] at the [[2019 Match Play Championship]].

== Source ==
Crop of the 8:00 still from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88-rZP-hBMA MPC 2019 Interview: Consolation Winner Trevor Partridge], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee YouTube, 1 May 2019). Overlay names Trevor Partridge Consolation Bracket Champion. Still: Players Committee.

== Changes ==
